name: Madison to Jefferson, "Buried Cipher"
status_at_source: Madison heavily cancelled the coded passage and wrote "Undecypherable" in the margin
exclusion_reason: found-solved: Irving Brant (Madison biographer, 20th c.) was first to penetrate the cancellation and decode it; a well-known named case in Madison scholarship

name: Jefferson to Madison, coded passage
